question: Which sport is played by the Indian sportsperson Leander Paes?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Lawn Tennis**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• **Leander Paes** is a renowned Indian sportsperson known for his achievements in **Lawn Tennis**.
 
• He has won numerous Grand Slam titles in both men's and mixed doubles categories.
 
• Paes is considered one of the greatest doubles players in the history of tennis.
